intro: Tomb Weed is an alchemical quest assigned by Junior Apothecary Holland in Tirisfal Glades. Holland has been modifying wild doom weed and replanting it at the haunted Balnir Farmstead, cultivating a potent new specimen that unexpectedly attracts the local Scourge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.
Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... Drawn... To the weed. Curious.
